d: A standard skirt block (skirt sloper) drafted with the classic British Bray method

seatEase.d: How much ease to add at the hip line. The book drafts 6 cm, and allows trimming it back to 4 cm for a tight fashion fit

lengthBonus.d: How much longer than the knee measurement the skirt should be, measured on the center edge

silhouette.d: How much the skirt flares below the hip line

silhouette.standard.d: The standard block, with 1.7 cm of spread at each knee-line boundary

silhouette.straight.d: The straight variant, with 1.2 cm of spread at each knee-line boundary
